svg.title: Buying-Group Order Survival Loop
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-buying-group-order-survival; chapter number: 1; title: Buying-Group Order Survival Loop; subtitle: Reserve, buy capped units, ship to the posted address, log the SKU, collect ACH; chart type: process_flow; stages: step: 01; label: Reserve the Deal First; value: Step 1; detail: Commit before researching, because reservations hold only a 12 to 24 hour window (Lets Get To The Points).; step: 02; label: Buy in $500-$1,000 Orders; value: Step 2; detail: Keep each checkout between $500 and $1,000 after a $2,000 Target order was flagged; pay through PayPal, Apple Pay or Shop Pay with the billing address set to the prep center (John Muscarello).; step: 03; label: Ship Only to Posted Address; value: Step 3; detail: Ignore Discord DMs from 'admins'; impersonators redirected about $20k of goods (Geobreeze Travel).; step: 04; label: Log the Exact SKU; value: Step 4; detail: Wrong color or model means no reimbursement and payout prices can change; do not resubmit failed orders while pending charges take 5-7 days (Lets Get To The Points, John Muscarello).; step: 05; label: Collect ACH and Keep the Points; value: Step 5; detail: The spread usually runs 2-5 percent, rarely 10; about $250,000 a year at 4x is roughly 1M points (Frequent Miler).; caption: Members buy household-capped items on their own cards, ship to the group warehouse, get reimbursed by ACH or check, and keep the rewards.; assumptions note: Margins and order sizes are as reported by the named practitioners; never float more than the bank balance, after an attendee reported losing $60,000 (Geobreeze Travel).; note: Sources - Frequent Miler, John Muscarello, Lets Get To The Points, Geobreeze Travel, Czech It Out Money Hacks.

rect.title: step: 01; label: Reserve the Deal First; value: Step 1; detail: Commit before researching, because reservations hold only a 12 to 24 hour window (Lets Get To The Points).

text.title: Commit before researching, because reservations hold only a 12 to 24 hour window (Lets Get To The Points).

rect.title: step: 02; label: Buy in $500-$1,000 Orders; value: Step 2; detail: Keep each checkout between $500 and $1,000 after a $2,000 Target order was flagged; pay through PayPal, Apple Pay or Shop Pay with the billing address set to the prep center (John Muscarello).

text.title: Keep each checkout between $500 and $1,000 after a $2,000 Target order was flagged; pay through PayPal, Apple Pay or Shop Pay with the billing address set to the prep center (John Muscarello).

rect.title: step: 03; label: Ship Only to Posted Address; value: Step 3; detail: Ignore Discord DMs from 'admins'; impersonators redirected about $20k of goods (Geobreeze Travel).

text.title: Ignore Discord DMs from 'admins'; impersonators redirected about $20k of goods (Geobreeze Travel).

rect.title: step: 04; label: Log the Exact SKU; value: Step 4; detail: Wrong color or model means no reimbursement and payout prices can change; do not resubmit failed orders while pending charges take 5-7 days (Lets Get To The Points, John Muscarello).

text.title: Wrong color or model means no reimbursement and payout prices can change; do not resubmit failed orders while pending charges take 5-7 days (Lets Get To The Points, John Muscarello).

rect.title: step: 05; label: Collect ACH and Keep the Points; value: Step 5; detail: The spread usually runs 2-5 percent, rarely 10; about $250,000 a year at 4x is roughly 1M points (Frequent Miler).

text.title: Collect ACH and Keep the Points
The spread usually runs 2-5 percent, rarely 10; about $250,000 a year at 4x is roughly 1M points (Frequent Miler).
Assumptions: Margins and order sizes are as reported by the named practitioners; never float more than the bank balance, after an attendee reported losing $60,000 (Geobreeze Travel).
